text:
Nico (billing): Heads-up: noticed ~40 Stripe refunds not linked to NetSuite invoices this morning, totals ~ $6.8k. Mostly small customer refunds.
refund-bot: stripe-webhook-processor: errors=42, unmapped_refunds=42, last_error=2026-04-10T05:12:03Z
Elena (payments): Which webhook? refund.succeeded? Could be our mapping layer failing to find charge->invoice mapping.
Rajat (eng-platform): I'll tail the processor logs. Quick check shows X-Forwarded-Client header was stripped by proxy for a subset of events around 05:10. That header is used to lookup tenant mapping.
Marta (accounting): If refunds aren't applied, customers show negative payments in AR. Need fix before daily statements.
Nico (billing): Query to find orphan refunds:
```
SELECT r.id, r.amount, r.created_at, r.stripe_charge_id, r.mapped_invoice_id
FROM refunds r
WHERE mapped_invoice_id IS NULL
AND r.created_at >= '2026-04-10 05:00'
ORDER BY r.created_at;
```

Will paste results in 5.
refund-bot: found=42 orphan_refunds sample_ids=[rf_3001,rf_3002,rf_3003]
Rajat (eng-platform): Root cause: new proxy rule for health checks inadvertently removed X-Forwarded-Client for POSTs under 10kb. Hotfix: preserve header for /webhooks/stripe POSTs. PR incoming.
Elena (payments): Remediation options: 1) replay webhooks from Stripe for that time window, 2) run a reconciliation that matches refunds by charge->customer heuristics and auto-apply. Prefer replay if we can guarantee idempotency.
Rajat (eng-platform): Our webhook consumer supports idempotency via header ext_id. But the events came through with ext_id set, so replay is safe. I'll enable replay and monitor.
Jon (CFO): Approve replay. Prioritize applying customer-facing refunds ASAP.
Marta (accounting): After replay, I'll run a reconciliation and confirm AR balances. Please add a guard so missing header triggers an alert.
Rajat (eng-platform): Deploying proxy patch now and kicking off Stripe event replay for 05:08-05:15 window. ETA ~12m.
refund-bot: replay_job started job_id=replay-2153330001-1 events=58
Nico (billing): Thanks. Tag me when all mapped so we can unblock statements.
refund-bot: replay_job complete job_id=replay-2153330001-1 processed=58 applied=42 conflicts=0 audit=/logs/replay-2153330001-1
Marta (accounting): Confirmed refunds applied, AR reconciled. Closing.
Nico (billing): Please add postmortem to weekly ops notes and an alert for X-Forwarded-Client missing rate > 0.05%. :thumbsup:
